mapper.select: SELECT a.USER_NM ,a.LANG_CD ,b1.CMM_CM_NM AS LANG_NM ,a.STATE_CD ,b2.CMM_CM_NM AS STATE_NM ,a.ROLE_CD ,b3.CMM_CM_NM AS ROLE_NM ,a.BIRTH_DT ,a.GENDER_CD ,b4.CMM_CM_NM AS GENDER_NM ,a.PHONE_NUM FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b1 ON a.LANG_CD = b1.CMM_CDV AND b1.CMM_CD_ID = 'LANG_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b2 ON a.STATE_CD = b2.CMM_CDV AND b2.CMM_CD_ID = 'STATE_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b3 ON a.ROLE_CD = b3.CMM_CDV AND b3.CMM_CD_ID = 'ROLE_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b4 ON a.GENDER_CD = b4.CMM_CDV AND b4.CMM_CD_ID = 'GENDER_CD' WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT a.CMM_CDV ,a.CMM_CM_NM FROM TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D a WHERE a.CMM_CD_ID = #{cmmCdId}

SELECT b.TOUR_ID ,b.TOUR_NM ,b.SIDO_CD ,c1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM ,b.SGG_CD ,c2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM ,b.ROAD_ADDR ,b.DETAIL_ADDR ,b.ZIP_CD ,CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.CATE_CD ORDER BY d.CATE_CD) AS CHAR) AS CATE_CD ,CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY e.CMM_CM_NM) AS CHAR) AS CATE_NM ,AVG(a.REVIEW_SCORE) AS AVG_SCORE ,b.FIRST_IMAGE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b ON a.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D c1 ON c1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' AND c1.CMM_CDV LIKE CONCAT(LPAD(b.SIDO_CD, 2, '0'), '%') LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D c2 ON c2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' AND c2.CMM_CDV LIKE CONCAT(LPAD(b.SIDO_CD, 2, '0'), LPAD(b.SGG_CD, 3, '0'), '%') LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE d ON b.TOUR_ID = d.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D e ON d.CATE_CD = e.CMM_CDV AND e.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' WHERE b.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY b.TOUR_ID ,b.TOUR_NM ,b.SIDO_CD ,c1.CMM_CM_NM ,b.SGG_CD ,c2.CMM_CM_NM ,b.ROAD_ADDR ,b.DETAIL_ADDR ,b.ZIP_CD ORDER BY AVG_SCORE DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT b.MOIM_ID ,b.MOIM_TITLE ,b.MOIM_DSCR ,b.MOIM_START_DT ,b.MOIM_END_DT ,b.CREATE_USER AS USER_ID ,d.USER_NM ,CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.CATE_CD ORDER BY e.CATE_CD) AS CHAR) AS CATE_CD ,CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY f.CMM_CM_NM) AS CHAR) AS CATE_NM -- 별칭 중복 수정 ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER mm WHERE mm.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID AND mm.ROLE_CD = 'A') AS MEMBER_CNT ,b.MAX_MEMBER ,v.VISIT_CNT FROM ( SELECT MOIM_ID, COUNT(1) AS VISIT_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_VISIT_H GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) v INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST b ON v.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO d ON b.CREATE_USER = d.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE e ON e.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D f ON e.CATE_CD = f.CMM_CDV AND f.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' WHERE b.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY b.MOIM_ID ,b.MOIM_TITLE ,b.MOIM_DSCR ,b.MOIM_START_DT ,b.MOIM_END_DT ,b.CREATE_USER ,d.USER_NM ,b.MAX_MEMBER ,v.VISIT_CNT ORDER BY v.VISIT_CNT DESC LIMIT 5;
